comments.text: From audit prompt gist: 'Cryptography — == on secrets instead of Plug.Crypto.secure_compare/2.' Timing attacks allow extracting secrets byte-by-byte when using == for comparison. Flag == comparisons where one operand is a known secret source (password, token, api_key, secret, hmac). Suggest Plug.Crypto.secure_compare/2 or :crypto.hash_equals/2. Severity: Medium.

title: Elixir: detect timing-unsafe comparison on secrets (== instead of secure_compare)
